entries.subject: Fix incorrect default value
entries.notes: sync a57149e1f6: Relation view ON DELETE / ON UPDATE options are now RESTRICT, NO ACTION, CASCADE, SET NULL. packages/sql-gen/src/relation.ts (FK_ACTIONS) already used this order (exception X38); X38 is retired, the UI parity map rule for the selects and the parity suite's RESTRICT workaround are removed (tests/parity/table-relation.parity.test.ts now posts phpMyAdmin's form as-is), docs/features/04-table-level.md lists the new order.

entries.subject: Update Composer dependencies
entries.notes: sync a57149e1f6: phpmyadmin/sql-parser 6.0.0 -> 6.0.1 ported to packages/sql-lexer: Context OPERATORS gains -> and ->> (punctuation, flag 16); Formatter adds no space around -> / ->>; IntoKeyword::build escapes INTO columns with Context::escapeAll; AlterOperations no longer treats ASC / DESC of a key part as a statement start; SelectStatement::getTables skips unaliased tables in the alias map; Utils/Query getClause null keyword (our port was already null-safe); CustomJsonSerializer (setAccessible removal) has no TS counterpart. Fixtures regenerated with 6.0.1 (lexer, parser, split, lint, first-statement, format; the new parseAlterTableAddUniqueKey* corpus cases included), sql-gen fixtures re-stamped (no value changes). phpstan/phpstan-phpunit 2.1.1 and vimeo/psalm 6.19.2 are upstream dev tooling: not applicable.

entries.subject: Get export_item param from ServerRequest object
entries.notes: sync a57149e1f6: Events/RoutinesController read export_item / item_name / item_type through ServerRequest (string-typed, RoutineType::tryFrom) instead of $_GET; the export trigger becomes hasQueryParam('export_item') (an empty value now exports too). Our exports are dedicated endpoints (GET /api/servers/:s/databases/:db/routines/export?name=&type=, …/events/export?name=) with no export_item flag; definitions, titles ('Export of routine %s' / 'Export of event %s', backquoted name) and the not-found messages are unchanged, so nothing to port. phpstan/psalm baselines: upstream tooling.
